info.title: WebCraft Content API
info.description:
A Site's read-only API for frontends built elsewhere: its published content only, never Drafts.

It answers on each of the Site's domains and its Staging address under `/_content/v1`, once Staff switch it on (Site settings › Content API).

Every request carries one of the Site's Content keys in the Authorization header (`Authorization: Bearer webcraft-ck_…`), never in the address. A key reads published content only, so it may sit in browser code; browsers on other sites may send it only from the origins it lists (CORS, with preflights).

Limits: 600 requests a minute per Content key and 120 per client address, then 429 with Retry-After. Every answer carries RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Reset (seconds) of the limit closest to running out.

Caching: answers carry a strong ETag and `Cache-Control: public, max-age=0, must-revalidate`; `If-None-Match` gets 304. Every publish (Publish all, Scheduled publishes and unpublishes, AI translation's publishes included) gives new answers at once.

Languages: `lang` reads one of the Site's languages (on a language's own domain, that language unless given). A value with none of its own falls back one Field at a time through `fallback` (the Default language unless given; `none` for none), and `fallbacks` names each value read from another language. An Entry hidden in the language never appears there.

Versioning: changes within v1 are additive only; a breaking change ships as a new major version beside this one for at least 12 months, with a Deprecation header meanwhile.

servers.description: On each of the Site's domains and its Staging address.

CONTENT_API_OFF.meaning: The Site's Content API is switched off (the default).

NOT_FOUND.meaning: No such path in the Content API.

METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED.meaning: Only GET, HEAD and OPTIONS (a CORS preflight) are answered.

CONTENT_KEY_INVALID.meaning: The request carries no Content key (`data.problem`: `missing`), or one that isn't this Site's (`unknown`) or was revoked (`revoked`).

CONTENT_KEY_IN_QUERY.meaning: A key was sent in the query string, where logs keep it: send it in the `Authorization` header.

ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED.meaning: A browser on another site sent the request, and the key doesn't list its origin (`data.origin`).

TOO_MANY_REQUESTS.meaning: Past a limit (`data.limit`: `key`, 600 a minute per Content key, or `address`, 120 a minute per client address); wait `Retry-After` seconds.

QUERY_INVALID.meaning: The query string asks for something the API can't answer: `data.problems`, each with its `parameter` and `problem`.

POST_TYPE_NOT_FOUND.meaning: The Site exposes no Post Type with that key.

ENTRY_NOT_FOUND.meaning: No published Entry of that Post Type, shown in the language, is there.

ENTRY_GONE.meaning: The Entry was published, then unpublished.

MEDIA_NOT_FOUND.meaning: The Site has no ready Media item with that id (or it is in the Trash).

x-webcraft-query-problems.parameterUnknown: The path doesn't take this parameter.
x-webcraft-query-problems.parameterRepeated: The parameter is given more than once.
x-webcraft-query-problems.languageUnknown: The Site has no such language (`lang`, `fallback`).
x-webcraft-query-problems.fieldUnknown: No exposed Field of the Post Type (or the Globals) has this key.
x-webcraft-query-problems.fieldNotRelationship: Only a Relationship Field's related items take fields of their own (`category.title`).
x-webcraft-query-problems.tooDeep: Relationships are read one level deep.
x-webcraft-query-problems.tooMany: More values than the parameter takes.
x-webcraft-query-problems.filterUnsupported: The Field can't be filtered on this way (see the schema's `filters`).
x-webcraft-query-problems.valueInvalid: The value isn't one the Field (or the filter) takes.
x-webcraft-query-problems.sortUnsupported: The Field can't be sorted by (see the schema's `sortable`).
x-webcraft-query-problems.limitInvalid: `limit` is a whole number from 1 to 100.
x-webcraft-query-problems.cursorInvalid: The cursor isn't one this list gave, for this same query.
x-webcraft-query-problems.queryMissing: `q` is the text to search for.
x-webcraft-query-problems.pathInvalid: `path` is a path on the Site, starting with `/`.
x-webcraft-query-problems.notForPages: Pages are found by their path (`/entry?path=`), as their slugs repeat under different parents.

get.description:
Newest published first unless `sort` asks otherwise, 20 at a time (`limit`, up to 100); `next` is a cursor for the rest, to send as `cursor` with the same query.

Filters: `filter.<field>=<value>` (equality), `filter.<field>.in=<a>,<b>` (one of, up to 50), and for numbers and days `filter.<field>.gt|gte|lt|lte=<value>`; a Relationship by the id of what it points at. Which Fields take which is each Field's `filters` in the schema; `publishedAt` and `lastPublishedAt` take the ranges. Several filters must all hold.

One sort Field: `sort=<field>`, `-<field>` for descending (Fields whose `sortable` is true, `title`, `publishedAt`, `lastPublishedAt`); Entries without a value come last, then the Entry's id breaks ties, so pages never repeat or skip one.

contentKey.description: One of the Site's Content keys (`webcraft-ck_…`), made by Staff under Site settings › Content API.

fallback.name: fallback
fallback.description: Languages a missing value falls back through, in order, comma-separated; `none` for none. The Default language unless given.

body.name: body
body.description: How Body fields are answered: semantic HTML, the Blocks as stored (with their ids), or Markdown.

fields.name: fields
fields.description: The Fields to answer, comma-separated (every exposed one unless given; built-in values always come). `<relationship>.<field>` answers the Entries a Relationship points at with those Fields of theirs, one level deep.

cursor.name: cursor
cursor.description: A list's `next`, with the same query.

path.description: Where visitors find it on the Site, under its language's prefix.

url.description: Its absolute address for visitors (a language's own domain when it has one).

fields.description: The exposed Fields' values by key: text, numbers, true/false, days and times as text, a choice's value (or a list), Media as their details, a link as `{ url, text }`, a Relationship as Entry ids (or, asked through `fields`, those Entries), a Group's values by key, a Repeater's rows (`{ id, …}`), a Body field as `body` asks.

fallbacks.description: Each value read from another language than the one asked, by its path (`summary`, `origin.city`, `steps[1].text`), with that language.

next.description: A cursor for the next page; null on the last.

items.description: A Field: its key, label, type, whether it is translatable and required, its type's settings (options, multiple, postTypes, mode, integer, fields), and at the top level `filters` (operators) and `sortable`.
